newsitem.title: POLAND: Daiwa rates Polifarb Cieszyn as buy.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa rates Polifarb Cieszyn as buy.

text.p: Daiwa Europe Limited gave Polish paint maker Polifarb Cieszyn SA a "buy" recommendation, pointing out its growth potential on the Polish market, Daiwa said in its September report.
It said Polifarb's strength was exposure to significant growth areas within the Polish economy -- the construction and automotive sectors.
"Concentration on coatings that address specific industrial markets is likely to maintain market share and increase margins," the report said.
Polifarb currently has 27 percent of the Polish market.
Daiwa said it expected Polifarb's earnings per share to rise to 1.19 zlotys in 1996 and 1.82 next year, up from last year's 0.85 zlotys.
It said its price-earnings ratio was likely to fall to 10.1 this year and 6.6 in 1997, down from 14.1 in 1995.
Polifarb closed at 13.2 zlotys on Thursday, up from 13.0 at Wednesday's close
